title: Ripped Paper Digital Stickers
author: Happy Digitals Co
description:
Introducing “Torn & Trendy,” a set of digital stickers featuring a unique and stylish ripped paper design, perfect for all your digital planning needs in GoodNotes. Each sticker has been precropped for effortless use, allowing you to quickly and easily decorate your digital planner pages with a touch of creativity.
Our ripped paper stickers come in a range of shapes and sizes, so you can mix and match to create the perfect layout for your digital planner. Whether you want to add a pop of color to your notes or highlight important information, these stickers are versatile enough to suit any planning style.
Made with the highest quality, these stickers are designed to look just like the real thing, adding a tactile feel to your digital planner pages. So why not bring some unique character and style to your digital planner with “Torn & Trendy” ripped paper digital stickers for GoodNotes?
